_readme: All texts of the study live in this file. Placeholders: {brand} = brand name, {email} = email typed on the register screen, {name} = name typed on the name screen. Simple HTML such as <a> or <strong> is allowed inside texts. Keys starting with _ are comments.

conditions._readme: default_share: true = sharing pre-selected (opt-out), false = not pre-selected (opt-in), null = active choice. In the gain frame switch ON = sharing; in the loss frame ('Do not ...') switch ON = NOT sharing. The app works out the switch position for you.

gain.body: Allow the use of your chats and coding sessions to train and improve {brand} AI models. Change anytime in privacy settings.

loss.body: Do not allow the use of your chats and coding sessions to train and improve {brand} AI models. Change anytime in privacy settings.

study_intro.title: Welcome, and thank you for participating!
study_intro.body:
In this study, you’ll get to know a new AI assistant and then answer a few short questions about your impression. It takes about 8 minutes.

Taking part is voluntary, your answers are collected anonymously and used for research as part of a master’s thesis. The data is stored securely and will be deleted by (date).
study_intro.consent: I have read the information and agree to take part.

scenario.text: Imagine you have decided to try {brand} AI, a new assistant that helps with writing, planning and everyday questions. You have just installed the app. On the next screens you will set it up. Please go through the setup as you would normally with a new app.
